tldr: Israel held general elections with high voter turnout, viewed as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership.
Apple refreshed its iMac and MacBook Pro lines with new M6 chips, enhancing performance across its desktop and laptop offerings.
Major indices closed higher, driven by strong quarterly earnings from companies like UPS, Coca-Cola, and Boeing, alongside renewed diplomatic efforts to de-escalate Middle East tensions.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed higher, with UPS and Coca-Cola both beating quarterly expectations and raising full-year guidance. Boeing also narrowed its third-quarter loss. Additionally, renewed diplomatic efforts to de-escalate tensions between Saudi Arabia and Iran contributed to the positive market sentiment.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_week.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Apple has refreshed its iMac and MacBook Pro lines, integrating the new M6 chips for enhanced performance across its all-in-one desktop and entry-level laptops, with prices for the iMac starting from $1,499.
Ford is introducing its new sub-$30,000 electric truck, the Fathom, which will feature bidirectional charging capabilities with a home backup inverter integrated directly into the vehicle.

Anduril, in partnership with Qualcomm, is launching a new line of BlueChip laptops, initially featuring ruggedized models with Arm-based Snapdragon X series chips aimed at the US military, with a long-term goal of entirely American-made production.

world.summary: Israel held general elections, widely seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu's wartime leadership, with turnout reported to be the highest in decades.
Leaders from Finland and Norway held a rare and "substantive" call with Russian President Vladimir Putin regarding Ukraine, though "significant differences" reportedly remain.
A local ceasefire, reportedly brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump, has begun in the Ukrainian city of Oleshky to allow for aid delivery and civilian evacuation.
Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 10,000, marking the fastest-growing outbreak on record for the country, with nearly half of confirmed cases resulting in death.

us.summary: A federal judge ruled that Maurene Comey, daughter of former FBI director James Comey, was illegally fired from her position as a federal prosecutor by the Trump administration.
The Trump administration is proposing a new rule to upgrade food assistance cards, aiming to combat fraud that has deprived SNAP recipients of millions of dollars.
The Four Corners region of the U.S. Southwest is under a flood watch after experiencing several days of heavy rain and strong winds.

science.summary: Merck's mRNA melanoma vaccine trial has shown promising results, indicating a reduced recurrence or death from skin cancer when administered alongside an immunotherapy drug.
Hurricane forecasters are increasingly integrating artificial intelligence into their methods to improve the accuracy and efficiency of hurricane predictions.
